summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Orezi, the stage name of Esegine Allen, a Nigerian musician from Delta State. It notes that he rose to prominence in 2013 with his song "Rihanna". The note is very brief and gives no further career details.
one_line: Orezi is the stage name of Nigerian musician Esegine Allen from Delta State, known for his 2013 song "Rihanna".
key_facts: Esegine Allen, better known by his stage name Orezi, was born on 28 March 1986.
Orezi is a Nigerian musician from Delta State.
Orezi rose to prominence with his song "Rihanna" in 2013.
